display.purpose: Page titles and hero statements; light weight, tight tracking.

label.purpose: Uppercase section wayfinding in Sea-Glass Mint; 0.1em tracking.

mono.purpose: Step numbers, counters, timestamps; always tabular-nums.

shadows.name: mooring-glow
shadows.purpose: Brand-mark dot only — the lamp. Nothing else glows.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Every interactive element, 200ms — enforced by a base-layer hard rule.

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.purpose: Calmer alternative for larger ambient transitions.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.purpose: Standard press feedback for primary buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The mooring lamp: amber fill, ink-teal text, spring lift on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.75rem; min-height:3rem; padding:0.75rem 1.25rem; background:#ffd35c; color:#122630; font-weight:600; font-size:0.875rem; border:none; border-radius:0.8125rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all 200ms var(--ease-spring); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:rgb(255 211 92 / 90%); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #ffd35c; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; transform:none; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The floating workbench surface: harbor card, cream hairline, one soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { border:1px solid rgb(255 247 231 / 22%); border-radius:1rem; background:#274855; box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgb(4 18 24 / 18%); padding:1.25rem; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Section wayfinding label: small, uppercase, sea-glass mint.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-size:0.68rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.1em; line-height:1.2; text-transform:uppercase; color:#bceee4; }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: ideator·dev wordmark with the glowing gradient dot.
components.css: .ds-brand { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; font-family:Outfit, sans-serif; font-size:1.08rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.055em; line-height:1; color:#fff7e7; } .ds-brand__dot { display:block; width:0.3rem; height:0.3rem; margin:0 0.14rem 0.05rem; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #fde68a 0%, #fbbf24 52%, #f97316 100%); box-shadow:0 0 0 0.08rem rgb(251 191 36 / 10%), 0 0 0.52rem rgb(251 191 36 / 58%); }

narrative.overview: The interface is a sheltered body of water at night: one deep calm surface (Harbor Water #1d3440), warm cream text, and a single warm lamp (Mooring-Light Amber #ffd35c) marking where action happens. Half-formed work floats on translucent panels with hairline cream borders; depth is pure CSS — one soft shadow, a 56px workbench grid, and radial glows, never imagery. Amber is rare and structural (actions, focus, brand dot); Sea-Glass Mint (#bceee4) is the wayfinding voice. Every interactive element answers with a 200ms spring easing that vanishes entirely under prefers-reduced-motion. The visuals extend the product's binding copy voice: plain, direct, evidence-flavored — the workspace exposes weak thinking rather than decorating it.
keyCharacteristics: One dark teal water family for all surfaces
Amber as lamp (actions/focus/dot), mint as wayfinding
Light-weight tight-tracked display type in Outfit
Pure CSS depth; no photography or illustration

rules.name: The Mooring-Light Rule
rules.body: Amber is the lamp, not the paint — actions, focus, and brand dot only; never a background wash or text color.

rules.name: The Warm Cream Rule
rules.body: Text is always Lamplight Cream or Mist Green; never pure white or pure gray.

rules.name: The Quiet Voice Rule
rules.body: Large type is light and tight-tracked; bold 700 is reserved for the brand mark and tiny emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat until interaction; lift is a response to hover/press, panels never gain shadows on hover.

dos: Do build new surfaces from the theme tokens
Do keep the 200ms spring feedback on every interactive element
Do use the eyebrow + mono-index pattern for wayfinding
Do keep copy plain, direct, and evidence-flavored
donts: Don't hardcode raw Tailwind palette colors in product surfaces
Don't use amber as a background wash or text color
Don't introduce a third accent or pure white/gray text
Don't fabricate social proof (no testimonials or press exist)
Don't add shadows beyond panel-float and mooring-glow, or decorative imagery
